sourceNote: dean&david publishes its "Nährwerte dean&david, Stand: September 2026" as a four-page PDF (2026-09-dd-Naehrwertuebersicht.pdf, made on 18 September 2026), recorded with its address and SHA-256. It states per 100 g/ml and per portion: energy in kJ and kcal, fat, saturated fat, carbohydrate, sugar, protein and salt, no fibre, and no portion weight except the volumes of the smoothies (0,4 l) and the lemonade (0,3 l). An item without a stated weight is one serving of its per-portion figures, which must fit their own energy; a smoothie or lemonade is its stated volume, its per-100 column per 100 ml. The sheet calls its values calculated averages and says not every product is sold in every store. Salads are without dressing and bread, as the sheet says; bowls include their base and sauce. Left out: the catering curries and wraps, the components for mixing one's own salad or bowl, the add-ons, the bar's Crodino Spritz, the autumn pumpkin spice line and the specials sold only in participating stores.
sha256Note: SHA-256 of the PDF as downloaded; every row comes from it.
